entities.name: Xiang Jingyu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Xiang Jingyu was one of the earliest female members of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), and described by Chairman Mao Zedong as the only female founder of the CCP, widely regarded as a pioneer of the women's movement of China.
